_comment: A path belongs in `credentials` when reading it would hand over a secret or private correspondence — keys, tokens, password and keyring stores, mail, browser profiles. Keep it in step with .claude/settings.json in BOTH directions (make check-guardrails-native-sync): Claude has native deny rules as a second layer, pi has only this hook, so a path listed there and not here leaves pi uncovered. Path guardrails. Single source of truth consumed by the shared core (~/.agents/guardrails/core.ts), used by Claude and pi via their adapters. Paths only, no logic. See README.md. Credentials are blocked for read/write/bash. Machinery is blocked for write/bash but allowed for normal read tools, so agents can inspect their own guardrails without gaining persistence-edit access. `machinery_enabled` is per-agent and should only be disabled while bootstrapping.
